Privileged operator migration intentionally handles wrapped vault/private/org keys, server verifiers, API keys and TOTP/recovery material. This is local secret custody, not anonymous export. Source IDs never choose local filenames; archive child paths are opened no-follow under retained roots, regular single-link files and actual file/HTTP byte intake are bounded. SQLite archive row counts are not globally capped by this control. Credential-bearing API requests retain their selected origin; signed file downloads may use another HTTPS origin, carry no account bearer and refuse redirects. Live files use random exclusive scratch names. Non-Unix archive file bytes fail closed; see operator compatibility documentation. 2026-10-31: crates/provider-bitwarden/Cargo.toml now pins aes 0.9.2 and cbc 0.2.1 with features alloc and block-padding unchanged (cipher 0.5.2). Encrypt and decrypt still use PKCS7 via encrypt_padded_vec and decrypt_padded_vec; type-2 HMAC is checked before decryption. reqwest, response caps, and origin pinning in that manifest are unchanged. cargo test -p opensesame-provider-bitwarden passed, including response_limits (13), pinned_origin (5), crypto unit tests, and fast crypto vectors. Ignored production-KDF and regenerator tests were not run. bitwarden-server import path tests were not re-run; this diff does not change those sources.

LOCAL device-owner process custody only. Original session/scope and transport-bound completions retain ownership; cancel, expiry and lock synchronously revoke provisional key/body/VFS custody. Before configured factors and trusted quorum complete, a revocable private IAM handle permits only bounded policy/directory/credential reads and genuine WebAuthn assertion-counter advancement, with no ordinary VFS, key export or consumable IAM sign-in evidence. Activation and leases publish once under their original owner; metadata, preferences and device-key reconciliation retain operation checks. Bound regressions use genuine sealed stores, real contact assertions and controlled completion boundaries. Copied vault artifacts with primary unlock material can be decrypted outside this local gate: this is neither offline cryptographic quorum nor global lifecycle enforcement. Source fingerprints require deliberate source-path review and executed relevant regressions after every change; they do not prove crash atomicity or cancel already accepted physical writes.

Local admitted provider-result custody. Reviewed original transport and captured revision through private record reads, authenticated decryption, final revision locks, generic API resources, configured OAuth publication and registered API dispatch with or without a caller signal. Actual held-WebCrypto/Web-Lock/physical-close/public-mapping regressions and live-value positives plus bound provider, PKCE, storage and bridge consumers. No copied-secret revocation or global lifecycle claim.
